label: H.Res. 1292
title: Recommending that the House of Representatives find United States Attorney General Merrick B. Garland in contempt of Congress for refusal to comply with a subpoena duly issued by the Committee on the Judiciary.

items.snippet: This resolution finds Attorney General Merrick Brian Garland in contempt of Congress for failing to comply with a congressional subpoena.

items.item: House Judiciary Committee to the United States Attorney's Office for the District of Columbia
items.snippet: It also directs the Speaker of the House to (1) certify the related report from the House Judiciary Committee to the United States Attorney's Office for the District of Columbia for criminal proceedings, and (2) take all other appropriate action to enforce the subpoena.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.note: Not checked against lobbying filings (118th Congress bill; 2025-2026 filings are not searched for it).

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

J000289.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
J000289.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
J000289.note: No lobbying list to compare for this bill.
